I’m Gary—just got laid off last week, my disability appeal’s stuck in limbo, and my doctor said this jacket isn’t optional—it’s medically necessary to prevent another hypothermic episode. I’ve been sleeping in bus shelters because my heating got cut off, and I’m down to $117.43 in my account… *total*. I saw your $180 jacket, but that’s more than I have to live on for the next *three weeks*. I’ll be honest: I’ve already messaged three local thrift co-ops and two consumer rights forums about your pricing—I’m sharing screenshots of this chat with my chronic illness support group tonight unless we land on something survivable.  

This isn’t haggling. It’s triage.  

### BUYER_PRICE($65) ###
